CR - 1. It is recommended that the malfunctioned Ballast Water Treatment System should be dealt with as soon as possible but not later than 05 December 2026 as per the Dispensation Application (No. ES-2026-0673 date 07 October, 2026) granted by the Flag Administration.
2. The Dispensation Application (No. ES-2026-0673 date 07 October, 2026), which is valid until 05 December 2026, must be kept on board at all times together with the Ballast Water Management Certificate.
